name: VeriScore
why_it_matters: Newsrooms need to verify individual statistics and claims against authoritative sources, and VeriScore measures exactly that pipeline of extracting check-worthy claims and grounding them in retrieved evidence.
task_shape: Given long-form model output, extract verifiable claims, retrieve supporting web evidence, and score each claim as supported or unsupported, producing a factual precision and recall metric.
signals: Focuses only on check-worthy, verifiable claims rather than penalizing subjective or non-factual sentences, which better matches editorial fact-checking workflows.
Verification depends on general web search rather than curated authoritative databases, so results can reflect source quality issues rather than pure model accuracy.
